title: Russo-Georgian War
summary: In August 2008 Russia, together with South Ossetian and Abkhaz forces, fought Georgia after fighting around Tskhinvali in South Ossetia escalated into open warfare on 7 August. A ceasefire was signed on 12 August, and about 192,000 people were displaced. On 26 August Russia recognised South Ossetia and Abkhazia as independent states.

uncertainty.note: Sources differ on who began the fighting; one source dates hostilities from 1 August, others from 7 August.

where.modern_name: Tskhinvali, South Ossetia, Georgia (proxy pin: city where open warfare began; the war spread across Georgia)

importance.justification: Regarded as the first European war of the 21st century; led to Russian recognition of two breakaway regions.
